q_en: How do I tell someone to do something, or not to do it?
not_yet: The command of verbs with a long vowel in the middle: later.
The reason for the short end (a case name): not needed.
not_yet_ar: أَمْرُ الْأَفْعَالِ الَّتِي فِي وَسَطِهَا حَرْفُ عِلَّةٍ: فِي دَرْسٍ آخَرَ.
أَدَوَاتُ نَفْيٍ أُخْرَى لِلْأَفْعَالِ: فِي الدَّرْسِ ٢٥.
سَبَبُ السُّكُونِ فِي الْآخِرِ: لَا نَحْتَاجُ إِلَيْهِ الْآنَ.

lines: Who is the speaker talking to?
Does the verb start with the usual present letter? How does it start instead?
هَلْ يَبْدَأُ الْفِعْلُ بِحَرْفِ الْمُضَارِعِ؟ بِمَاذَا يَبْدَأُ بَدَلًا مِنْهُ؟
How does the end of the verb sound: long, or short and stopped?
كَيْفَ آخِرُ الْفِعْلِ: طَوِيلٌ أَمْ قَصِيرٌ سَاكِنٌ؟

slides.head_en: Make a command from the present
slides.big_en: Drop the prefix, add a helper letter, stop the end.
slides.small: The helper letter depends on the middle vowel of the verb. You will meet both kinds. Just read what is written.
slides.small_ar: حَرْفُ الْوَصْلِ يَتْبَعُ حَرَكَةَ عَيْنِ الْفِعْلِ. سَتَرَى النَّوْعَيْنِ. اِقْرَأْ مَا هُوَ مَكْتُوبٌ.

slides.head_en: Look: to a woman, to a group
sents: Go back to the ribāṭ! (to a man)

slides.head_en: A small change you will see
slides.big_en: Before a word that begins with “the”, the end gets a small kasra.
slides.small: Just read it as it is written. اُكْتُبِ الدَّرْسَ is still “to a man”. The command for a woman has a long ending: اُكْتُبِي.
slides.small_ar: اِقْرَأْ كَمَا هُوَ مَكْتُوبٌ. اُكْتُبِ الدَّرْسَ هِيَ لِلْمُذَكَّرِ أَيْضًا. وَلِلْمُؤَنَّثِ نِهَايَةٌ طَوِيلَةٌ: اُكْتُبِي.

slides.tip: To say “do not”, put the word لَا before the verb.

sents: Do not sit in front of the Habib!
Do not enter the mosque! (to a group)
Do not leave the house! (to a woman)

slides.why: A command to one man ends with no vowel at all. Correct: اُكْتُبْ. (The vowel at the end belongs to the statement يَكْتُبُ.)
slides.why_ar: الْأَمْرُ لِرَجُلٍ وَاحِدٍ يَنْتَهِي بِسُكُونٍ. الصَّوَابُ: اُكْتُبْ. (الضَّمَّةُ فِي يَكْتُبُ لِلْمُضَارِعِ.)

slides.why: After لَا the verb takes its present form: لَا تَكْتُبْ. The helper letter is only for a plain command: اُكْتُبْ.
slides.why_ar: بَعْدَ لَا يَأْتِي الْفِعْلُ بِصُورَةِ الْمُضَارِعِ: لَا تَكْتُبْ. وَحَرْفُ الْوَصْلِ لِلْأَمْرِ فَقَطْ: اُكْتُبْ.

can: I can make a command for a man, a woman and a group.
I can say “do not” with لَا and a short verb.
can_ar: أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أَصْنَعَ أَمْرًا لِرَجُلٍ وَلِامْرَأَةٍ وَلِجَمَاعَةٍ.
أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أَقُولَ «لَا» مَعَ فِعْلٍ قَصِيرٍ.
